messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Seamless Stitch: Sales → Success ops roster & kickoff window

Team — handing this one off from Aditya (deal signed yesterday; 12-month committed Dedicated plan). Key facts up front:

- Account: Aptiva Health (primary contact: Alex Garcia / Dir. Product)
- ARR: $420k committed (reserved GPU pool, SLA 99.9% during business hours)
- Start of paid term: 2027-08-01
- Primary success objectives: reduce inference latency for search feature to <120ms at p95, enable prefix caching for common clinical queries, and run monthly quality checks against seed prompt set.

Attached: mutual action plan (MAP) v2 and the draft SOW. Please review ownership columns under the MAP — I’ve pre-filled recommended owners.

Asks:
1) Tessa — can you own the post-sale CS lead? Recommended: be the primary point through go-live and first 60 days.
2) Mina — can you run implementation PM (timeline below assumes 4 sprints -> 5 weeks)?
3) Vivek — ticket for enterprise networking (VPC peering + KMS integration) — is that on your team or should we loop infra partner?

Proposed kickoff: week of 2027-07-26 (they prefer late-week). Alex is available 7/29-7/30. If that works, we should lock a 60-minute kickoff covers roles, timeline, and acceptance criteria.

Internal notes for CS: there is a one-time onboarding credit we offered (applied after acceptance) and a limited 30-day rollback window for model variant pinning. Also note they asked for a quarterly review cadence with their Security team — expect an initial security questionnaire next week.

Aditya — please add any missing deal-level nuance.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Seamless Stitch: Sales → Success ops roster & kickoff window

Adding a couple of quick clarifications from the negotiation:
- Contract: 12 months, auto-renew unless 60d notice. Pricing is locked for year 1.
- SLA: customer requested a 99.95% business-hours SLA initially; we landed 99.9% with a formal SLO exception approved by Legal (exported in the DA).
- Sensitive data: Aptiva will route patient-identifying strings through token hashing before we receive them; they expect audit logs displayed in Console and weekly delivery of anonymized log samples during onboarding.
- Trial integrations: they want test instances for our small-embedding model and the gpt-open-13b quantized variant for evaluation.

Also: Alex explicitly asked for a named escalation channel during the first 30 days (we should provide the on-call rotation).

I'll be on the kickoff to introduce the contract and closing notes. Great job getting this over the line.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao

- Can Aditya share the final signed contract PDF (redacted for PII) and the negotiated SLO exception doc? I want those in the customer folder before kickoff.

I’ll draft a kickoff agenda and send a calendar invite for 7/29 at 11:00 AM PT (60 min). If Alex confirms availability we’ll lock it.

Thumbs up — I’ll own the implementation PM and have sketched an initial sprint plan attached to this thread (MAP covers milestones; my doc has task-level owners). Quick items I’ll action:

- Sprint plan: 5 weeks (sprint 0 = sandbox prep, sprints 1–3 = integration + testing, sprint 4 = cutover and hypercare).
- Resource ask: please assign a model ops engineer for 2 days in sprint 2 (embedding eval), and reserve 1 infra engineer half-day during sprint 0 for VPC peering validation.
- Deliverables: test harness for latency bench, sample anonymized audit logs, and an acceptance checklist (I’ll share a draft before kickoff).

I’ll send the kickoff invite for 7/29 11:00 AM PT and attach my sprint plan + the versioned MAP.

—Mina
